cards.name: Blastoise
cards.flavorText: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.
cards.ability: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach 1 Water Energy card to 1 of your Water Pokémon. (This doesn't use up your 1 Energy card attachment for the turn.) This power can't be used if Blastoise is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
attacks:
Hydro Pump 40+
Does 40 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. Extra Water Energy after the 2nd doesn't count.

cards.name: Charizard
cards.flavorText: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.
cards.ability: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into Fire Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can't be used if Charizard is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
attacks:
Fire Spin 100
Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard in order to use this attack.

cards.name: Venusaur
cards.flavorText: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.
cards.ability: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may take 1 Grass Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and attach it to a different one. This power can't be used if Venusaur is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
attacks: Solarbeam 60

cards.name: Dark Gyarados

cards.ability: When Dark Gyarados is Knocked Out by an attack, flip a coin. If heads, this power does 20 damage for each Water Energy attached to Dark Gyarados to the Pokémon that Knocked Out Dark Gyarados. Apply Weakness and Resistance. attacks:
